GraceChangeDesignContext.Rationale: This package closes audit findings F10 and F11 and the highest-value exfiltration paths from the threat model. Browser traffic and feature traffic need different physical enforcement while sharing capability semantics.

Alternatives.Alternative: Route every byte through one generic proxy. Rejected because engine update, service workers, downloads, and platform integrations have different enforcement and failure paths.
Give a feature one user-approved filesystem root or API token. Rejected because broad reusable authority is hard to revoke and easy to exfiltrate.

DeferredDecisions.Decision: The transport selected for high-volume streams is deferred to benchmarks and platform support.
Credential-store backend selection is deferred; non-exportable broker semantics are normative.

Scenarios.Scenario: A feature may fetch one approved API origin but a redirect to a private address or different host is denied before connect.
A downloaded artifact can be inspected through a byte handle but cannot be exported to an arbitrary path without separate consent.
